summary.headline: Planetary Distances and Jewish Calendar
summary.text: Calculation of the Sun’s and Moon’s distances from the universe’s center using ephemeris tables, orbital-diameter units, seconds, and parasangs, followed by the ordered months and simple or leap-year structure of the Jewish calendar. The account explains the repeated Adar and the timing of Tishrei around Libra, commemorating Moses’s crossing of the Nile Sea and Pharaoh’s destruction.
